description: Freight performance dashboard: Sustainability is a dataset listed in the DITRDCSA Data Catalogue under the National Freight Data Hub group, published by Roads and Maritime Services. Data on the average age of freight vehicles by year and the number of electric and hybrid freight vehicles registered in the NSW. Average age calculations are based on difference between vehicle manufacture date and current date. For purposes of context the number of light trucks, prime movers and heavy trucks are also shown. Coverage is New South Wales, 2016 onward; spatial detail follows the source and is not stated in the entry. The catalogue lists the update frequency as annual, the status as current, and the entry was last changed on 2022-10-24. Files and pages listed: HTML (1 resources), reached from the source page and the catalogue entry, with the CKAN API giving the metadata. Access is free of charge and open; the licence is not stated in the catalogue entry (source page not read). Caveats: the record was written from the catalogue metadata only, so the source page was not opened, the file contents were not checked, and many entries are HTML landing pages or PDF reports, not data files. It can support network flow and freight or traffic assignment models and capacity and investment planning studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ditrdcsa-data-catalogue-australia.
